platform.implementation: x86_64 C -O3 benchmark, data preloaded from binary files; timing excludes file I/O and model loading
platform.clock_note: host CPU dynamic frequency; not bare-metal FPGA timing

limitations: The benchmark input is already fused point sets; it does not include filesystem/raw-index loading.
k=7 target association/history-buffer maintenance is not separately timed here.
All feature modes currently call the same compute21 core then select subsets, so this is a conservative software proxy for hardware cost.
